new_findings_today.title: SOS ambulance/mountain_rescue fields sometimes hold honest-scarcity text ('Not reliable', 'Not available', 'N/A — day trip') instead of a phone number — a real, DB-wide, deliberate pattern, not a data defect
new_findings_today.detail: Today's Section E sample flagged agatti's ambulance field as 'malformed' (text with no digits) by the harness's crude phone_ok() check: the DB value is literally 'Not reliable'. Investigated further rather than accepting the harness's classification at face value: a DB-wide scan of all 9 relevant SOS columns across all 533 rows for non-numeric values found 12 total instances, and every single one follows the same honest pattern — 8 are ambulance fields on Andaman/Lakshadweep islands genuinely reachable only by day trip or without ambulance infrastructure (north-bay-island, barren-island, little-andaman, baratang-island, bangaram, kadmat, ross-island, minicoy, long-island-andaman all read 'Not available' / 'N/A' / 'N/A — day trip'), and 2 are mountain_rescue fields (athirapally, phawngpui-peak) that explain why no phone is published and redirect to the correct government department instead of fabricating one. agatti's own row (verified_by='constants-reverify-2026-06-09', a real verification pass, not an accidental artifact) fits this same pattern and still carries 6 other genuinely dialable fields plus a named rescue_contact with 3 real numbers. This is the site's own 'honest scarcity over fabrication' principle applied to a phone field rather than an empty one — not a bug.
new_findings_today.evidence: DB scan: `SELECT destination_id, col, val FROM (...9-column UNION ALL...) WHERE val !~ '[0-9]'` returned exactly 12 rows, all matching the pattern described above (full list in qa/findings/2026-07-10/ SQL transcript). agatti emergency_sos row: police=100, ambulance='Not reliable', fire=101, women_helpline=1091, tourist_helpline=04896-262258, road_accident=1073, rescue_contact='Deputy Collector Agatti: 04894-242263 / 9447822714 · Police Control Kavaratti: 04896-263100 · Coast Guard MRCC: 1554', local_police_station='Agatti Police Station' — 6 dialable fields, well above the 3-field safety floor.
new_findings_today.recommendation: No data fix needed — this is deliberate and verified content. Two low-priority process suggestions: (1) extend the SKILL.md Section E note's existing local_police_station text-only allowlist to also cover this ambulance/mountain_rescue honest-scarcity pattern, so future daily runs don't have to re-derive this each time a fresh destination lands in the random sample; (2) optional UX polish — pairing 'Not reliable'/'Not available' ambulance values with an inline pointer to the nearest working alternative (most rows already have one in rescue_contact) would help a traveler reading the SOS card in an actual emergency, though the information is technically present elsewhere on the same card today.
